latvia.description: Senatoarea Nicoleta Pauliuc a cerut să nu mai fie filmată, pe holurile Parlamentului, când reporterii Context.ro au întrebat-o detalii despre avere, în contextul în care din acest an politicienii nu mai sunt obligați să-și publice declarațiile de avere, conform unei decizii a Curții Constituționale din august 2026. Mai mult, senatoarea împinge cu degetul microfonul reporterului […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Estonian real estate developer to build new city district in Latvia's Riga
latvia.description: Estonian real estate developer Invego plans to demolish Riga's Skonto, the home stadium of the Latvian national football team, and will build a new, modern urban district in its place.

latvia.title: More migrants caught in Tallinn, 1 foreigner found dead in apartment
latvia.description: A 21-year-old man from Pakistan was confirmed dead by police at an apartment in Tallinn on Saturday. Eight illegal migrants who said they had traveled from Latvia to Estonia were also found in the same location.

latvia.title: Maritime Museum orders €1 million research vessel from Latvia
latvia.description: The Estonian Maritime Museum is purchasing a new research vessel, with construction set to take place in Latvia. The catamaran will be the first research vessel built specifically to the museum's requirements.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1721. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Kushner ja Witkoff kohtuvad Euroopa esindajatega enne USA-Ukraina-Venemaa kõnelusi Abu Dhabis
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1721. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis. 2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: Kushner ja Witkoff kohtuvad Euroopa esindajatega enne USA-Ukraina-Venemaa kõnelusi Abu Dhabis
latvia.description: USA presidendi Donald Trumpi erisaadikud Jared Kushner ja Steve Witkoff kohtuvad Euroopa esindajatega enne USA, Ukraina ja Venemaa kolmepoolseid kõnelusi Araabia Ühendemiraatides Abu Dhabis, teatas Kushner eile sotsiaalmeediaplatvormil X, edastas uudisteportaal Ukrinform.

latvia.title: Ukraina tennisetäht keeldus venelannaga ühispildist, WTA loobus 20 aasta pikkusest traditsioonist
latvia.description: Ukraina tennisetähe Elina Svitolina keeldumine Venemaa ja Valgevene mängijatega ühispildil poseerida võis saada saatuslikuks naiste tennise katuseorganisatsiooni WTA ligi 20 aastat kestnud traditsioonile.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvia’s Foreign Minister Baiba Braže addresses emergency session of UN Security Council
latvia.description: On 9th November 2026, an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine has been called by Latvia.

latvia.title: ERR: Estonian company to replace Skonto stadium with new urban quarter
latvia.description: Estonian real estate developer Invego plans to demolish Riga's Skonto stadium, the home of the Latvian national football team, as part of a new urban construction project, reports Estonian public media ERR.

latvia.title: Sex criminal handed lengthy sentence after years of abuse
latvia.description: The man admitted his guilt and entered into a plea agreement with the prosecutor.

latvia.title: Latvian house prices remain relatively affordable
latvia.description: New Eurostat data published on November 9th shows that while Latvia's house prices continue to rise fairly quickly, real estate remains fairly affordable for locals when compared with some other parts of Europe.

latvia.title: Slower driving on Dienvidu Bridge in Rīga as of Friday
latvia.description: Starting 13 November, on the Dienvidu Bridge flyovers in Riga, the speed limit will be reduced from 70 km/h to 50 km/h during the winter season.

latvia.title: Who let the dogs out? Call for clarity over canine leash laws
latvia.description: Seven animal protection associations have appealed to the Latvian Union of Local Governments, calling on them to ensure that pet owners have clarity about when and where they can let their dogs off the leash.

latvia.title: Mini-series dramatises Latvia's national alert info
latvia.description: Latvia's State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD) has published a series of short videos on the subject of emergency preparedness.

latvia.title: Lielīvande manor complex looking for new hands
latvia.description: Kuldīga Municipal Council is determined to find a new owner for the Lielīvande Manor complex. The auction for the property will begin on 11 November, with a starting price of 371,000 euros. At present, it is the only place where the residents of Īvande can gather; the building still houses the parish council and the library, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Defence Minister Melnis ready to carry on regardless
latvia.description: Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis would be ready to continue working in his post even if Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) forms a government without the New Unity party, Melnis said on Monday in the Latvian Television programme "Morning Panorama".

latvia.title: Tourism in eastern Latvia was hit by drone alerts
latvia.description: The tourism industry in Latvia's eastern border region has been doing its best to recover from a wave of cancelled reservations in May and June, according to the Ministry of Economics (EM).

latvia.title: Drug users in Latvia getting younger, doctors observe
latvia.description: Organisations working with children and young people have observed that children are getting drunk on alcohol or taking drugs at an increasingly young age – even at primary school age. The number of children admitted to hospital requiring medical assistance following intoxication is on the rise, Latvian Television reported on November 8.

latvia.title: Latvia chairs emergency UN meeting on Ukraine
latvia.description: On 9th November 2026, Minister of Foreign Affairs Baiba Braže will be in the New York (USA) to take part in an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus France international handball
latvia.description: Enjoy live handball action on Sunday as Latvia's men's team takes on France at the Zemgale Olympic Centre in Jelgava.

latvia.title: Phone scammers rampant in Latvia
latvia.description: This year, telephone scammers have swindled more than 17 million euros from Latvian residents. The number of fraud cases shows no sign of decreasing, and most often the scammers pose as representatives of banks, the State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD), courier services or the State Revenue Service, Latvian Radio reported on November 9.

latvia.title: Latvia continues to secure eastern border
latvia.description: Construction of the Baltic defence line continues along Latvia’s eastern border. To hinder the movement of a potential adversary’s vehicles, anti-tank trenches are being dug and concrete obstacles, known as ‘dragon’s teeth’, are being installed. First, trenches are planned to be dug over 89 kilometres, of which four kilometres have been excavated so far. The first 27 kilometres are due to be completed next spring, Latvian Television reported on November 8.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: First snow of winter falls in Latgale region
latvia.description: The first snowflakes of the season were recorded at the Rēzekne observation station on Saturday morning, according to information published by the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 6th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian government judges itself to have done pretty well
latvia.description: On November 6th, 2026, the Cabinet of Ministers reviewed a report prepared by the State Chancellery on the implementation of the action plan of the government led by Andris Kulbergs. According to its findnings, by October 15th, 2026, 52 out of 61 priority ministerial tasks, or 85%, had been completed, as well as 132 or 71% of the total 185 measures included in the government action plan.

latvia.title: Workers offered chance to improve Latvian language skills
latvia.description: In order to promote the competitiveness of employees and facilitate their inclusion in the work environment, the State Employment Agency (NVA) will offer the opportunity to acquire or improve Latvian language skills free of charge within the framework of the lifelong learning activities of the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+) project “Support for Adult Education”.

latvia.title: Contraband cigs thrown from moving train in Latvia
latvia.description: On 4 November, the State Police detained two Belarusian nationals – a train driver and his assistant – on suspicion of large-scale smuggling. The men threw several packets of illegal cigarettes from a moving train.

latvia.title: Average Latvian salaries are lowest in the Baltics
latvia.description: In 2025, the average annual full-time adjusted salary for employees in the EU was €41 500, reflecting a 4.3% increase from €39 800 in 2024, according to Eurostat data published on November 6th.

latvia.title: Latvia discusses electronic warfare with partners willing to help Ukraine
latvia.description: This week, a plenary session of the Electronic Warfare Coalition took place in Latvia, during which coalition representatives discussed current challenges in the field of electronic warfare, as well as the necessary support for Ukraine to strengthen this capability.

latvia.title: Nepal declines Latvian humanitarian aid
latvia.description: Nepal, which was hit by devastating floods at the end of August, has declined the humanitarian aid offered by Latvia, which had been prepared by the Emergency Medical Service (NMPD) and the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD), and consequently, on Friday 6 November, the government revoked the order to provide humanitarian aid to Nepal.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Porta, Patriotic Walk, Belts
latvia.description: The Month of Patriots has begun in Latvia. What will it be this weekend?

latvia.title: Rīga Book Festival starts today
latvia.description: On November 6th and 7th, the traditional Riga Book Festival will offer a rich programme at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia's influenza vaccination rate low, death rate high by EU standards
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data for 2023 and 2024 show that Latvia had one of the lowest rates of influenza vaccination and one of the highest rates of death from influenza.

latvia.title: Latvian public invited to mark Lāčplēsis Day on November 11th
latvia.description: On Lāčplēsis Day (November 11th), commemorative events will be held throughout Latvia, with the participation of soldiers of the National Armed Forces and allies.

latvia.title: Fuel prices up 34% on year in Latvia
latvia.description: Data published by Central Statistical Bureau on November 5 show that, compared with October 2025, the average level of consumer prices for fuels for transport in October 2026 was 34.5 % higher. Diesel prices increased by 38.1 %, petrol prices by 27.9 % and auto gas prices by 12.9 %.

latvia.title: Mārupe, Daugavpils named most business-friendly areas in Latvia
latvia.description: Mārupe Municipality has been recognised as the most business-friendly municipality, whilst Daugavpils has been awarded the status of the most business-friendly city, according to the Latvian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LTRK).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 5th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: New Saeima deputies start to settle in
latvia.description: After being sworn in earlier this week, Latvia's Saeima deputies are starting to settle in – but that comes with several challenges.

latvia.title: Latvia's 2027 Michelin Guide has 35 restaurants
latvia.description: In the fourth year of the Latvian ‘Michelin’ Guide, a further 12 Latvian restaurants have been added to the selection, according to Michelin.

latvia.title: 14th Saeima's top speakers revealed
latvia.description: Over the past four years, the 14th Saeima adopted a total of 1,078 laws - 140 new ones and 938 amendments to existing laws according to a summary of the activities of the 100 Saeima deputies.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvian Foreign Minister speaks at NATO command centre
latvia.description: Latvia's Foreign Minister Baiba Braže was in the Netherlands on November 4th at NATO’s Allied Joint Force Command Brunssum and participated in an informal meeting of foreign ministers.

latvia.title: Over half of Latvia's internet users also use AI
latvia.description: According to the annual Central Statistical Bureau survey on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in households and by individuals, published on November 5, 58.2 % of internet users in Latvia used generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools in 2026, 23.1 percentage points more than a year earlier.

latvia.title: Major drug bust in Rīga's woods
latvia.description: On 21 October this year, the State Police seized approximately 36 kilograms of various drugs in Rīga, Jūrmala and the surrounding area, the majority of which had been hidden in barrels buried in the ground in the woods. A group of six people has been arrested on suspicion of drug trafficking, the police said.

latvia.title: Dozens more illegal crossings prevented on Latvia-Belarus border
latvia.description: On Wednesday, November 4th, State Border Guard officers prevented 22 people from illegally crossing the Latvian-Belarusian state border, according to the border guard's own figures.

latvia.title: New Rīga city councillors take up their seats
latvia.description: At the Riga City Council meeting on Thursday, November 5th, 13 new deputies were approved – a knock-on effect of the recent parliamentary elections which saw numerous Rīga city councillors elected as Saeima deputies.

latvia.title: New Saeima deputy in trouble on day one
latvia.description: A newly-elected member of Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, has found himself in hot water on his very first day in the job.

latvia.title: Rīga to look for budget savings for next year
latvia.description: Next year, Riga will have to contribute 24 million euros more to the municipal equalisation fund than this year, so Riga City Council will be looking for ways to make savings, as confirmed by Riga’s Deputy Mayor Vilnis Ķirsis (New Unity) on the Latvian Television programme ‘Morning Panorama’ on November 5.

latvia.title: Rīga outlines November celebration plans
latvia.description: During the upcoming week from Lāčplēsis Day (November 11) to the 108th anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia (November 18), the Rīga Municipality is inviting residents and visitors to various events in the capital.

latvia.title: Experts ponder why some foods are expensive in Latvia
latvia.description: Why are oils and fats in Latvia the second most expensive in the European Union (EU), after Switzerland? This was one of the issues discussed by economists, industry representatives and experts at a debate organised by the Competition Council (KP) on Wednesday, 4 November, Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Smiltene decides to lock doors of gambling halls
latvia.description: Gambling venues that have been operating in Smiltene for more than 20 years could disappear from the town by 2031. Following the district council’s decision to close two gambling halls, the law stipulates that they will have to cease operations in five years’ time, provided the gambling operators do not challenge this decision, Latvian Television reported on November 4.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Experts offer crisis situation advice to Latvian public
latvia.description: What to discuss with children and what medicines to prepare for a crisis situation – representatives of emergency services and other experts shared various recommendations to improve the preparedness of residents in crisis situations during a discussion on Latvian Television on Wednesday, November 4th.

latvia.title: Use of AI gradually increasing among Latvian businesses
latvia.description: In 2026, 18.5 % of companies in Latvia will be using artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, 6.3 percentage points more than in 2025, according to the Central Statistical Bureau's annual survey on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) and e-commerce.

latvia.title: Shortage of flu vaccines in Latvia
latvia.description: There is still a shortage of flu vaccines in Latvia for both children and adults. GPs point out that neither state-funded nor private flu vaccines are currently available. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has indicated that vaccine deliveries to Latvia should take place in the coming weeks, Latvian Radio reported on November 4.

latvia.title: Police drills to take place at Rīga Central Station at night
latvia.description: On the night of 4 to 5 November, a crisis simulation exercise organised by the State Police in collaboration with the state-owned company “Latvian Railways” and the passenger rail operator Vivi will take place at Riga Central Railway Station.

latvia.title: Industrial output slightly up on year in Latvia
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau calendar-adjusted data at constant prices, published November 4, show that in September 2026 industrial production output increased by 2.6 % year on year.

latvia.description: Sveicināts erudīcijas testā par Latvijas pilsētām! Šeit tev būs jāparāda savas zināšanas, atbildot uz 10 āķīgiem un aizraujošiem jautājumiem. Noteikumi ir vienkārši – uz katru apgalvojumu jāatbild tikai ar “jā” vai “nē”. Sāc, kad esi gatavs!

În cazul copilului de doi ani, este o premieră: este cel mai tânăr pacient transplantat până acum în România. Salvarea a venit tot de la un copil, care s-a stins la nici un an și jumătate.

lithuania.title: PSD pregătește reforma administrativ-teritorială: șase criterii pentru reorganizarea localităților. Când va fi gata documentul

Printre cele luate în calcul se numără populația, sustenabilitatea economică, capacitatea administrativă, conectivitatea, accesul la servicii de bază și infrastructura publică. Europarlamentarul social-democrat Dragoș Benea, coordonatorul grupului de lucru pentru reformă, a precizat luni că primarii își vor duce actualele mandate până la capăt, în 2028, și că nu trebuie să existe temeri în această privință.

lithuania.description: Dėl pirmadienio vakarą surengtų Rusijos atakų Ukrainoje padidinta Lenkijos oro gynybos parengtis, praneša Lenkijos vyriausybinio saugumo centras.

lithuania.title: Ukraina ir Rusija dabar sutaria bent dėl vieno: Melania Trump turi būti laiminga
lithuania.description: Po beveik penkerių karo metų Rusija ir Ukraina dabar sutaria bent dėl vieno dalyko: Melania Trump turi būti laiminga.

lithuania.title: Kaip karą Ukrainoje mato Putinas? Iš rusų generolų jam – suklastoti vaizdo įrašai
lithuania.description: Rusijos karinė vadovybė, tikėtina, teikia Vladimirui Putinui suklastotus, dirbtiniu intelektu (DI) sukurtus vaizdo įrašus, kuriuose vaizduojamos išgalvotos Rusijos kariuomenės pergalės Ukrainoje. Apie tai praneša „Financial Times“ (FT), remdamasis Rusijos prezidentui artimais šaltiniais.

lithuania.title: Buenos Airėse popiežių Leoną XIV sveikino daugiau nei du milijonai žmonių
lithuania.description: Į popiežiaus Leono XIV pirmadienį Buenos Airėse aukotas mišias, pasak vietos pareigūnų, susirinko daugiau nei du milijonai tikinčiųjų, o piligrimai atvyko iš visos Argentinos ir nakvojo palapinėse, kad galėtų bent iš tolo pamatyti pontifiką.

lithuania.title: JAV tikisi pažangos derybose Abu Dabyje, tačiau taikos susitarimo nelaukia
lithuania.description: JAV pareigūnai optimistiškai vertina būsimų trišalių derybų Abu Dabyje perspektyvas. Tačiau nesitikima, kad per lapkričio 10–11 dienomis vyksiančius susitikimus pavyks pasiekti susitarimą.

lithuania.title: Merzas pagrasino visai ES, jei nepadės Ukrainai
lithuania.description: Vokietijos kancleris Friedrichas Merzas pareiškė blokuosiantis kito septynerių metų Europos Sąjungos biudžeto priėmimą, jei visos valstybės narės neįsipareigos finansiškai remti Ukrainos 2027 metais ir vėliau.

lithuania.title: Prezidentas sako nesuprantantis, kodėl URM slepia informaciją apie pokalbius su Taivanu
lithuania.description: Šalies vadovas Gitanas Nausėda sako nesuprantantis, kodėl Užsienio reikalų ministerija (URM) slepia informaciją apie pokalbius su Taivanu dėl atstovybės pavadinimo keitimo.
